EMAIL_CENTER.TITLE: Email Center

SENDER_PROFILES.TITLE: Operational sender stack

PROFILES.SYSTEM_NO_REPLY: Automated sender for OTP, password reset, verification, and system-only messages.
PROFILES.PUBLIC_CONTACT: Public contact sender for contact-form responses and general correspondence.

NOTES.ADMIN_INVITE: Send immediately when a new admin user is invited into the control center.
NOTES.ACCESS_RESET: Used when administrative access is reset or reissued.

NOTES.DISPUTE_ESCALATION: Escalates SLA breaches and sensitive disputes to risk leadership.
NOTES.SETTLEMENT_DIGEST: Daily finance digest for payout, reconciliation, and blocked exposure review.
NOTES.SUPER_ADMIN_ACCESS_INVITE: Notify invited super admin identities and their owning managers when access is provisioned.
NOTES.VENDOR_BRANCH_INVITE: Trigger when a branch operator or branch manager receives a new vendor-panel invitation.

NOTES.DRIVER_VERIFICATION_UPDATE: Routes verification state updates for driver identities and compliance teams.

NOTES.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_RECOVERY: Secure recovery workflow for customer account access and follow-up support.
NOTES.CUSTOMER_ORDER_CONFIRMED: Sends only when an order is confirmed after payment/COD placement.
NOTES.CUSTOMER_ORDER_OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: Sends only when an order reaches OnTheWay status.
NOTES.CUSTOMER_DRIVER_ARRIVED_AT_DELIVERY: Sends only when the driver marks arrived at customer.
NOTES.CUSTOMER_ORDER_IMPORTANT_UPDATE: Sends only for major order/payment changes.
NOTES.VENDOR_WEEKLY_SUMMARY: Sends Mondays at 09:00 Asia/Riyadh when the vendor had order activity last week.
NOTES.VENDOR_APPROVED: Automatically dispatches when the vendor account is approved.
NOTES.VENDOR_PASSWORD_RESET: Automatically dispatches when a vendor password reset is triggered.
